verdict.rationale: Poke is a consumer AI assistant, so whether a user can opt out of model training on their conversations is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers training data use, privacy settings, or an opt-out control. The account-merging, integration-disconnect, and prompt-leak items do not address this story.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models
